age.evidence: A single cohort of 12 male C57BL/6J mice (The Jackson Laboratory # 000664) was purchased for in vivo studies

sex.evidence: A single cohort of 12 male C57BL/6J mice (The Jackson Laboratory # 000664) was purchased for in vivo studies

dosing.evidence: Dose-response studies for 4-PrO-DMT (0.03 -30 mg/kg s.c.) were conducted first... Saline was used as the vehicle control for all drugs except M100907. Mice were tested every 1-2 weeks with a minimum of 7 days between treatments

group_housing.evidence: Mice were single housed after temperature transponder implantation.

day_night_flipped.evidence: housed in a 12/12 lightdark cycle with lights on at 0700 local time... Experiments were conducted between 0900-1700 local time during the light phase.

assays.assay_description: After 5 min acclimation and s.c. injection (0.03-30 mg/kg 4-PrO-DMT, plus antagonist pretreatment experiments with M100907 and WAY100635), mice were placed in modified open-field chambers for 30 min; HTR events were recorded with overhead GoPro camera and scored using CleverSys TopScan software.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were administered to mice at 0.01 mL/g body weight via s.c. injection on the back.

setup_habituation.evidence: followed by a brief 5 min acclimation to the testing chamber.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were injected with various doses of 4-PrO-DMT, and returned to the testing chambers for 30 min.

food_restriction.evidence: Mice had ad libitum access to food and water [in home cage]; testing in open field chambers with no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Mice had ad libitum access to food and water [in home cage]; testing in open field chambers with no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: mice were injected with various doses of 4-PrO-DMT, and returned to the testing chambers for 30 min.

sample_size.evidence: A single cohort of 12 male C57BL/6J mice... Data represent mean ± SEM HTR count for n = 5-6/dose.

outcomes.summary: 4-PrO-DMT produced a dose-dependent, inverted-U increase in HTR significant at 0.3-3 mg/kg s.c., with HTR peaking 5-10 min post-injection. HTR was blocked by 5-HT2A antagonist M100907. At 10 mg/kg HTR was suppressed but unmasked by WAY100635 (5-HT1A antagonist) pretreatment.
outcomes.statistics: Ascending limb HTR potency ED50 = 0.31 mg/kg s.c.; one-way ANOVA with Tukey's/Dunnett's post hoc; p < 0.05 vs vehicle.
outcomes.evidence: Mice treated with 4-PrO-DMT exhibited increases in HTR frequency at doses from 0.3-3 mg/kg s.c. that were statistically higher than HTR in vehicle controls... 4-PrO-DMT induced a typical inverted U shape dose-response curve for HTR, with an ascending limb potency to produce HTR of 0.31 mg/kg s.c.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The mean HTR count over the 30 min testing period... were used for the statistical comparisons.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Time-course of dose-related HTR produced by 4-PrO-DMT over the 30 min session... HTR counts peaked from 5-10 min post injection and waned to control levels by the end of the session.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is a pharmacologically-induced stereotyped response, not an ethological behaviour per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Each mouse was tested alone in the chamber.

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR is a reflexive motor response, no learning required.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analyzed after each experiment using a computer software-based scoring platform (Clever Sys Inc. TopScan)

E1_environment_type.evidence: Open field chambers used for the studies (Coulbourn Instruments, Holliston, MA, USA)

E2_shelter.evidence: Open field chambers modified with cylindrical inserts and custom flooring — no refuge.

E3_bedding.evidence: custom flooring useful in aiding software-based detection of HTR events

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in test chamber.

E5_enrichment.evidence: modified with cylindrical inserts and custom flooring only.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse was tested alone in the chamber.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in chamber during 30 min session.

D1_continuity.evidence: returned to the testing chambers for 30 min (single recording session per drug administration; testing days are independent dose conditions).

D2_session_duration.evidence: returned to the testing chambers for 30 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Mice were tested every 1-2 weeks with a minimum of 7 days between treatments... Dose-response studies... were conducted first, followed by antagonist reversal studies.

D4_baseline.evidence: Baseline HTR not recorded; only baseline temperature was measured.

D5_followup.evidence: Acute dose-related effects over 30 min testing period only.

assays.assay_description: Distance traveled (cm) in the horizontal plane measured via photobeam tracking in the modified open-field chamber over the same 30 min post-injection session as HTR.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were administered to mice at 0.01 mL/g body weight via s.c. injection on the back.

setup_habituation.evidence: followed by a brief 5 min acclimation to the testing chamber.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice freely moving in the open field chambers.

food_restriction.evidence: Ad libitum food/water in home cage; testing in open field chambers without food.

water_restriction.evidence: Ad libitum food/water in home cage; testing in open field chambers without water.

time_to_assay.evidence: After injection mice were returned to the testing chambers for 30 min.

sample_size.evidence: Data represent mean ± SEM for n = 5-6/dose.

outcomes.summary: 4-PrO-DMT dose-dependently decreased distance traveled at 3-30 mg/kg s.c. (ED50 = 4.8 mg/kg). Hypolocomotion coincided with the descending limb of the HTR curve. WAY100635 pretreatment trended toward rescuing the hypolocomotion at 10 mg/kg but the effect was not statistically significant.
outcomes.statistics: ED50 = 4.8 mg/kg s.c.; one-way ANOVA with Tukey's/Dunnett's post hoc; p < 0.05 vs vehicle.
outcomes.evidence: The descending limb of the inverted U shaped HTR curve coincided with significant decreases in locomotor activity and body temperature (3-30 mg/kg s.c.) relative to vehicle controls.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total distance traveled (cm) was the sole locomotor metric.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total distance traveled across the session was used for statistical comparisons.

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance is not an ethological behaviour per rubric.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: locomotor activity was measured with photobeam tracking of distance traveled — beam-break system.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects placed in chamber.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in chamber during 30 min session.

D1_continuity.evidence: Single 30 min session per drug administration.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Mice were tested every 1-2 weeks; dose-response and antagonist studies span multiple test days.

judge_notes: Candidates split the open-field session into 1 vs 2 assays. Per rubric, the same apparatus measuring different behavioural domains = separate assays — split into HTR, Locomotor Activity, and Body Temperature.

Body temperature is a physiological measure, but it is presented as a key behavioural/in vivo readout in the study with full dose-response and antagonist arms, so it is included as its own assay entry parallel to HTR and locomotion (per candidate consensus that it constitutes a separate measurement domain).
Schedule = 'acute' (not 'repeated'): each test day involved a single dose with ≥7 days between treatments to avoid tolerance — this is acute single-dose pharmacology, not repeated dosing.
B7 scored 0 for all assays: TopScan is on the rubric's SCORE-0 list (CleverSys position tracking); photobeam tracking is also explicitly score 0.

D1 for temperature scored 1 (multiple discrete sessions) because baseline and post-session readings are explicitly two recordings of body temperature on the same test day; HTR and locomotor have only one continuous recording session each.
